status: reproduced, fixed and locally checked; not deployed
bug: Casting and basic attack admission/impact primarily trusted the DEAD state label. Real dispatcher/impact repros demonstrated zero/negative-health and disconnected actors could commit abilities and attacks while the label was stale. Direct hostile targeting also admitted such recipients. This is a game-layer gap; no assertion that ordinary players can bypass existing transport ownership gates is made.
fix: PerformAbility requires a player entity, positive health, non-DEAD state and connected status before any mana/cooldown/combo/cast mutation. Basic attack initial/commit admission and post-wind-up source/target checks also require positive health and connected status. The existing direct-target helper now requires living/connected recipients for hostile targets as well as support. Existing type, scene, range/body radius, wall/rock, relationship, PvP and control rules remain. No schema, power, balance, resurrection ability, saved health or projectile-in-flight behavior changed.
